publisher: Pemprov DKI Jakarta / DSDA / Jakarta Satu
license: Dataset-specific open license not stated; publisher attribution required; permission to redistribute remains unconfirmed.
simplification: Radial 1 metre; endpoints retained; 6 decimal coordinates. No topology reconstruction.
limitations: Reference geometry only; no publication epoch, capacity, operating state, measured direction or hydraulic connectivity. PANJANG=0 and TOPONIMI=0 can be source placeholders. Named administrative fields are retained without spatial reconciliation.

tiles.lowZoomPolicy: Tippecanoe drop-densest-as-needed; tiled simplification means not every admitted feature visible at each zoom.

clipping: No geometry cropped. Features required wholly within declared bbox; no out-of-bbox exclusions in this snapshot.
